resolution: Joint type handling, resolved across req_1055->1057. First made the joint type a strict choice (req_1055) instead of a free string. Then the user, seeing that type was a connector vocabulary (not the joint-vs-pivot distinction they'd assumed), ruled it out of authoring entirely (req_1057): joints bind by their explicit NAME (model.joint.<name>), so type-matching is unnecessary and 'generic covers all the bases'. End state: MountPoint.type is now OPTIONAL and dormant (absent = generic; mountsCompatible tolerates a missing type), kept STRICT (JOINT_TYPES) for a possible future composition layer but no longer surfaced in the UI; the type chooser was removed from the column-3 panel and both + joint buttons create typeless joints. Also (req_1056) the viewport overlay now labels each handle by its placement NAME ('back_left', not 'joint'/'generic') plus its travel, and the pivot is always labeled, so binding targets read off the model. editMesh 42/42, bundles clean; hot-reload TSX, uncommitted. PLAYBOOK Part 6 + memory updated.
